Hero.lede: Over 5 years building high-scale financial platforms. Currently at Pix, with technical focus on architecture and deliveries like Scheduled Recurring Pix, Automatic Pix and others. I enjoy complex problems — and use AI to solve them faster.

About.title: Building the silent infrastructure of money.
About.lede: I started in automated QA, scaled quickly to fullstack, and today I design critical architectures in the Pix core.
About.p1: I am a Senior Software Engineer focused on highly scalable and resilient financial and payment systems. My trajectory — from QA to Senior in just over 5 years — is defined by mission-critical deliveries in the Java/Spring Boot ecosystem.
About.p2: Currently at Pix, I work on architectural improvements and regulatory implementations from the Central Bank, such as Scheduled Recurring Pix, Automatic Pix, while also contributing to the performance of Pix.
About.p3: Before that, I gained extensive experience in a complete technology migration of an insurance system at Banco Sicoob (Flex → Angular, with DB2 tuning) and designed from scratch a People Management Platform in Java/Quarkus microservices + Angular 12.
About.p4: Day-to-day, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code are part of my workflow — not as shortcuts, but as amplifiers of quality and delivery speed. In personal projects, I go further: I build applications that integrate LLMs directly.
